issues.detail: The Greek 'χωρια' (chōria) refers to villages/settlements, but the Vietnamese translates it as 'ruộng' (fields/farms).
The Greek 'τω πρωτω της νησου' (the first of the island) is omitted or collapsed into the description of the village.
The Vietnamese adds 'của người tù trưởng' (of the chief), which is not present in the Greek text.
